retrieval_plan_assertions.explain_boundary: PostgreSQL represents SECURITY DEFINER SQL-function calls as a Function Scan. The gate therefore EXPLAINs the callable as the app role to prove the invocation boundary, then EXPLAINs the fingerprinted installed function body with its owner/RLS semantics to assert nested search_chunks plan nodes.

Plans.One-Time Filter: ((current_setting('app.context_valid'::text, true) = 'true'::text) AND (NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id'::text, true), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_credential_id'::text, true), ''::text) IS NOT NULL))

contract.definition: Completed sqlx::query events inside the HTTP request scope. Includes authentication, transaction context/setup, application SQL, and COMMIT. Excludes SQLx's protocol-level BEGIN because SQLx 0.9 does not emit a query event for it. Detached usage bookkeeping is intentionally outside the foreground request scope.

open.variability: Exact plus lexical retrieval with semantic disabled.

checkpoint.variability: The fixture has no explicit source_refs but contains one inferred Markdown path in checkpoint state.

resume.variability: Checkpoint read, changes page, continuation exact lane, and lexical fallback with semantic disabled.
